description: A Regex expander carrying one gate output per line; it goes immediately to the right of a Regex or Regex Condensed module

outputs.text: The gate for that line of the Regex beside it: on a clock expression it stays high for a whole step rather than pulsing, and on a pitch expression it carries that line's pitch negated

notes: this does nothing unless a Regex or a Regex Condensed module is placed immediately to its left.
beside a Regex, which has eight lines, only the first eight outputs are written; the other four hold whatever they last had.
on a pitch expression the voltage here is the negative of what the Regex itself puts out, which reads as a mistake by the maker rather than a feature.
